what: First launch after sign-in: link where you sell, each site on its own and each optional, then take a photo of the first thing. Two steps to a first listing.

frame.who: A new person, signed in a minute ago, with nothing linked or listed (world new); most often the person clearing out.
frame.how_often: Once, and again only after signing out.
frame.came_to: Get the first thing listed with the least setup.
frame.costly_mistake: A step that blocks: a site that will not sign in, or a question that could wait. Every site can be skipped, a failed sign-in says why and offers Try again, and Continue never waits for all five.
frame.ways_out: Skip for now with nothing linked; Later on the photo step goes to Today; a site's 2FA or captcha shows its own step, and a timeout gives Try again (spec/ways-out.md).
frame.in_the_loop: The person signs in on the site's own page; the password never reaches secondhand, and the page says so.

states.shows: the wordmark, 1 of 2, Your sites, the line that each is optional, five rows by logo each Not linked with Link, the password line, and Skip for now at the foot
the row tapped says Signing in with its pill spinning; the other rows stay tappable; the foot is unchanged
a linked row says Linked with a check; the line counts the sites linked; the foot says Continue in black
Mercari's first try: Didn’t link, The code from your phone timed out, and Try again; the rest unchanged
Back, 2 of 2, First photo, the line about one photo, Later, and Take a photo at the foot

controls.on_tap: starts that site's sign-in: Signing in, then Linked
the first try times out at the code step and offers Try again; the second links
goes to the photo step, whatever is linked
goes back to the sites step with what was linked kept
finishes first launch and opens the camera over Today
finishes first launch and opens Today

back: The sites step has no Back: it is the first screen after sign-in. The photo step goes back to the sites step.
decisions: Two steps, not the seven in spec/pages.md §6.1: sign-in is already done, and email for sales, pickups and alerts are asked the first time each is needed, so nothing stands between a new person and a first listing (the brief: the fewest steps to the first listing).
No carousel and no promises: the first screen is the first task.
The wordmark sits in the nav on the first step, which is the first screen a new person sees after sign-in; the photo step has Back instead.

Every site has its own state and act, and Continue works with none linked (Ben, 03:22). With none linked the foot reads Skip for now in gray; with one it reads Continue in black, so the black pill appears once there is something to continue with.
The import of found listings is left to Today as merge cards, so linking never waits on a scan.
Mercari's first Link in the demo times out at the code step, so the failed state and Try again can be seen.
